svg.title: Order and inventory platform architecture
svg.desc: Browser and API traffic, asynchronous order processing, notifications, reporting and monitoring. The order confirmation email handler is planned.
svg.text: Order and inventory platform
Project architecture · components are deployed as needed for each learning session
Web and API traffic · Terraform managed
Cloudflare DNS resolves stockroom.tarunapps.com to CloudFront.
Browser → HTTPS → CloudFront + WAF
Pages and assets → OAC → private frontend S3
/api/* → HTTPS + shared origin header → ALB
ACM certificates protect both HTTPS connections.
Mumbai VPC · Public subnets contain the ALB
ALB → ECS Fargate API → RDS in private subnets
API returns presigned URL → browser uploads to private S3
WAF is attached. Its Terraform coverage is pending.
Order processing · Terraform managed
API → one RDS transaction saves the order, inventory change, job and pending outbox message.
ECS publisher polls outbox → SQS → ECS worker polls for jobs. Repeated failures → order DLQ.
Worker updates job and order in RDS → adds OrderConfirmed to outbox → publisher sends it to EventBridge.
Docker image → ECR → ECS. IAM roles and security groups control access. Secrets Manager holds database credentials.
Reporting and operations · Earlier manual exercises
EventBridge rule → SNS → operations email
App and infrastructure → CloudWatch logs and metrics → alarms → SNS → operations email
Scheduler → inventory Lambda → reads RDS, writes S3 report, sends link through SES
Scheduler delivery failures → separate Scheduler DLQ
Planned · OrderConfirmed → EventBridge rule → confirmation Lambda → SES → customer email
Terraform manages the event bus and ECS log groups. Notification targets, reporting and alarms still need Terraform coverage.
